summary: Frontend Pre-Book Review tiles + Orders filter + Rename drop tested at 1920x800 via public URL. Tile values, filter click behavior (active ring, subtab switch, chip, toast), chip clear, total-tile clear, rename drop, and SKU Demand toggle all work. Only issue found: mock order counts per channel don't match the review spec.

ui_bugs.issue: Review request specifies DIST=3 rows (badge=3) and USW=1 row (badge=1), but seeded orderList has DIST=2 (#443, #441) and USW=2 (#444, #442). Filter and badge counts correctly reflect the underlying (incorrect) mock; hence dist badge shows 2 (expected 3) and usw badge shows 2 (expected 1). Total remains 4.

issues: Console warning (non-blocking): recharts ResponsiveContainer width(-1)/height(-1) warnings emitted repeatedly on mount — likely from mix bar or trend charts before layout settles. Suggest setting minWidth/minHeight or defer render until container has size.

action_items: Adjust mock orderList so Distributor has 3 orders and US Wholesale has 1 order to match Pre-Book Review spec (dist badge=3, usw badge=1, total=4).
Silence recharts width/height warnings by giving parent containers explicit dimensions.
critical_code_review_comments: PreBookPage.tsx is very large (>500 lines with dense JSX); consider extracting hero tiles, orders table, and rename UI into separate components.
orderRows filter/count is derived from a single mocked array; seed data should be moved to a fixture so the spec-expected 3/1 channel split is enforced.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All pb-stat-* tiles render exact expected values (13,328 / 932 / 12,396 with correct wholesale, MOQ hit, share, delta arrows, mix bar). Clicking a channel tile: (a) applies 'on' class ring, (b) switches to pb-subtab-orders (class active), (c) shows pb-chan-clear chip with correct label, (d) fires toast 'Showing <Channel> orders'. pb-stat-total or pb-chan-clear resets filter (chip disappears, all 4 orders shown). Rename via pb-more-btn → pb-rename-drop → pb-rename-input + Enter updates hero title and sidebar entry. SKU Demand subtab works. Only functional gap: seeded orderList has 2 DIST + 2 USW instead of spec's 3 DIST + 1 USW — badges reflect this correctly but not the requested values.
rca of the issue: Seed data mismatch: /app/frontend/src/PreBookPage.tsx lines 82-85 define 4 orders as USW/DIST/USW/DIST giving 2+2 split. Spec requires 3 DIST + 1 USW. Fix: convert one USW order (e.g. #442) to DIST, or add a 3rd DIST order and remove one USW.
